question: The Moatsu Festival is a time of great rejoicing as the planting season comes to an end. It is celebrated by the Ao tribes of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Nagaland.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Moatsu is a festival commemorated by the People of Nagaland.
 
• This is a festival of community bonding commemorated in May for 3 days.
 
• The festival is celebrated in the Ao town of Mokokchung, which is approx 150 km away from Kohima. 
 
• As a celebration, the villagers show their friendship for each other by exchanging presents, making new friends, feasting, bon fire etc.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
